result.clarifying_question: Your request asks me to summarize the high-risk-change rule and assess the documented exception 'today,' but no source packet, policy document, or referenced material was supplied. Can you provide the packet text (or a citable pointer to it) containing the high-risk-change rule and the exception you want assessed?
result.rationale: The request depends entirely on an unspecified packet of sources; without its contents, summarizing the rule or assessing the exception would require inventing authority and findings. Supplying the packet is a blocking, decision-changing prerequisite, not something I can resolve by guessing. Research itself is appropriate once the packet is provided.
